full_judgment: 8. It is argued on behalf of the petitioner that in view of the well settled principle of law that in the case of judgment of reversal justice demands a consideration of the materials which led to the reversal of the judgment of the trial Court and the reasons which weighed with it and that consequently the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division acted illegally in rejecting the revisional application of the petitioner in liming. We have carefully perused the judgment of the appellate Court, the final court of fact. The findings of fact arrived at by the appellate Court though at variance with that of the trial Court are found to be substantiated by evidence on the record and those are supported by logical reasoning’s. The learned Counsel for the petitioner could not substantiate his contention that the appellate Court did not at all advert to the reasoning’s of the trial Court in reaching its findings. The contention thus merits no consideration.
